scope: User-requested pinned DINO Skill transferability review for the ongoing Pro research packet. Research reference only; not executing DINO workflow and not authorizing new fits, private-label access, publication scope or rule changes.
already_present: frozen pretrained backbone and cache reuse
fit-only transforms and full prediction identity
paired controls and multiple model seeds

gaps_and_hypotheses.idea: Cheap simple head comparator on identical frozen embeddings
gaps_and_hypotheses.our_observation: Current build_head always has hidden Linear/ReLU/Dropout/Linear; admitted hidden dimensions128/256/512. No linear-only branch in this production runner.
gaps_and_hypotheses.research_request: Evaluate whether linear/logistic or regularized regression heads are useful matched low-cost controls; distinguish needing new interface from config-only and do not promise they beat MLP.

gaps_and_hypotheses.idea: Task-conditioned loss and class imbalance comparisons
gaps_and_hypotheses.our_observation: make_loss classification uses BCEWithLogitsLoss(pos_weight=[1.0]); regression uses MSE.
gaps_and_hypotheses.research_request: Compare no weighting with train-fit-only class weighting where justified; consider MAE/Huber vsMSE only for suitable regression tasks. Separate objective, stopping and external metric. Class-weighting not universally beneficial; current F010 improvement not evidence for weighted loss.

gaps_and_hypotheses.idea: Leakage-resistant stress tests within official train
gaps_and_hypotheses.our_observation: Current split groups exact raw Drug strings; fixed split seed43 and0.1 internal-stop. Model seeds vary; scaffold or canonical molecule grouping is not implemented here.
gaps_and_hypotheses.research_request: Assess train-only scaffold/similarity/canonical-identity grouped validation as additional robustness evidence. Keep official train/valid/test and raw rows/labels untouched; no retrospective independent-holdout claim for data already used. Do not assume original official splits are leaking.

gaps_and_hypotheses.idea: Model disagreement and representative difficult-case diagnostics
gaps_and_hypotheses.our_observation: Current diagnostics cover feature variance and prediction association; current comparison reports task/seed aggregates. No integrated task-aware cross-model disagreement review in this runner.
gaps_and_hypotheses.research_request: Propose no-label rank/prediction-disagreement, nearest-train similarity/scaffold/size and prediction-extreme slices with adequate group size; use existing outputs first. Any truth-based residual diagnostics remain designated-host scope and require explicit analysis admission; do not expose rowtruth to preparation/train or modify labels. Disagreement is not proof either model is wrong.

gaps_and_hypotheses.idea: Budgeted staged ablations and fixed comparisons
gaps_and_hypotheses.our_observation: Paired H0/F010, two model seeds, cached encodings and prior controls already implemented. Broader objective/head/representation designs are not yet systematically executed.
gaps_and_hypotheses.research_request: Reuse those foundations; propose cheap screening then shared-seed confirmation, fixed data-selection/split within each comparison, one-factor vsbundle clarity and full turnaround costing. Benchmark only genuinely new workload whose cost is unknown, not another pilot for every head.

gaps_and_hypotheses.idea: Treat representation settings as scientific choices
gaps_and_hypotheses.our_observation: Raw frozen features and fit-only preprocessing exist; F010 is already a representation-preprocessing experiment. Current production backbone is CheMeleon; alternative asset readiness remains separate.
gaps_and_hypotheses.research_request: Map the principle of explicit input-resolution comparison to molecular representation/preprocessing/approved frozen assets, not literal image resizing. Recommend candidate-specific cache provenance; avoid claiming greater model size necessarily improves generalization.

nontransferable_or_low_priority: Do not generate teacher labels for test/valid, import external unlabeled samples or overwrite official labels; original DINO human visual-label authority does not apply to measured ADMET outcomes.
Threshold/F1 optimization is not a direct improvement route for continuous-score AUROC/AP; no hard thresholding of submission predictions.
DINO distillation is an optional edge-deployment compression phase; current priority is predictive quality and no such permission is granted.
Its sealed-reference and mandatory owner-review gates are task-specific, not ADMET competition rules or an instruction to inspect every molecule manually.
No transplant of CLI workflow as a universal fixed deployment engine; preserve agent judgment with explicit scientific outcomes.
assurance: Current-code checks identify missing branches in this production runner, not proof no historical idea or experiment ever existed. Consult actual history before marking novel. DINO case-study results are not evidence of ADMET gains.
handoff: Include as externally sourced methods discussion in candidate index and ProQ2-Q4/Q6; existing candidate work unchanged, no repeated scoring/archive/prep audit.
